2. Vaṇṇupathajātaka Sandy Waste: a past life story

“Akilāsuno vaṇṇupathe khaṇantā, Digging untiringly in a sandy waste, Udaṅgaṇe tattha papaṁ avinduṁ; there at the underground stream he found water. Evaṁ munī viriyabalūpapanno, In the same way, a sage with strength aroused Akilāsu vinde hadayassa santin”ti. untiringly finds the peace of the heart.

Vaṇṇupathajātakaṁ dutiyaṁ.
